//: Shared TypeScript settings for every package under packages/. Added 2026-08-20 (P2 Task 2);
this is the repository's first TypeScript configuration.
strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess and exactOptionalPropertyTypes are on together because the
engine's whole job is arithmetic over sparse, optional, department-supplied data: an
unchecked index into a day vector and an optional parameter silently read as present are
both the shape of defect that produces a plausible wrong number rather than a crash.
lib is ES2022 with NO DOM, deliberately. This code ships to the browser, so the temptation
to reach a browser global is real and the type checker is the only thing that makes reaching
one a build failure rather than a runtime surprise in one of the two runtimes (D4).
module/moduleResolution are ESNext/bundler: Vite resolves these sources directly and nothing
consumes types across a package boundary until P3, so there is no declaration emit and no
build step of its own. noEmit is set here rather than per package so `tsc -p` is a CHECK
everywhere, never something that writes .js beside the .ts.
